settings.heading: Meet Your Coach
settings.body:
John Doe is a PGA teaching professional who has spent over 15 years helping everyday golfers fix their slices and find more fairways. He has taught thousands of lessons and specializes in making swing changes simple and repeatable.

The One Shot Slice Fix grew out of years of working with slicers on the range and seeing what actually works under pressure. This program distills those lessons into one clear system you can follow in a single focused practice session.

settings.question: How quickly will I see results?
settings.answer: Most golfers notice a significant reduction in their slice within the first focused practice session. The drill is designed to create an immediate feel change that carries over to the course.

settings.question: What if I’m a beginner?
settings.answer: This system was built for everyday golfers, including beginners. You don’t need tour-level swing knowledge — just a willingness to follow clear, simple instructions.

settings.question: Is this a physical product or digital?
settings.answer: The One Shot Slice Fix is 100% digital. You get instant access to all videos on your phone, tablet, or computer as soon as you complete your purchase.

settings.question: How long do I have access?
settings.answer: You get lifetime access to all lessons and updates. Re-watch the material any time you want a refresher before a round.

settings.question: What if it doesn’t work for me?
